topic: Data pipeline script debugging and deployment
summary_markdown:
The session focused on diagnosing data discrepancies in the analytics dashboard following a script run. An older, buggy SQL script (`db4_reaggr.sql`) was used to update the `device_session_agg_ml` table. The initial run caused missing or incorrect data for specific campaigns (VAC and ROTS) and general date ranges.

To resolve this, someone committed to re-running the script incrementally (August, then July, then June). The immediate goal was to generate enough data quickly for an upcoming client meeting. Finally, a discussion occurred regarding promoting the staging environment data to production.
decisions: The old SQL script needs debugging and updating to prevent future data corruption.
Data must be re-run incrementally (August, then July, then June) to restore dashboard accuracy.
action_items: Someone will continue running the historical data for previous months.
The staging environment needs to be promoted/deployed to production after successful validation.
